player_prompt.intro:
Kamuyki pukaraq {player_id} Connect Fourpi.
Tukay disk simbulu: {symbol}.
Juego tablakuqa {num_rows} uraykunayas {num_cols} columnakunayuq.
Pukarakuna p'unchaykunallam diskninta columnakunaman (0 kanan {end_col}) uraykuchkanku.
Wak p'unchay ñawpaqkuna (ninpakuna) tawa diskkunata verticalman, horizontalman, diagonalmanchasqanku atinku.
Ninpakam p'unchaykikuna, columnata numero sqala bracketkunapi ukhupi ruwayta ruwaykikikuna.
Sapaq example: '[col 4]' icha '[col 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Pukaraq {player_id}, Invalidu ruway formatu. Esperasqa formatu: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is out of bounds.
